speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Thou art late for a house that has been listening to a pie since the lane.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: We raced. I was first at the door. Judith says a race is not a race if nobody counted.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Nobody counted because it was not a race. It was thee running, and me walking, and the pie in neither of our hands.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The cloth is here. I carried it. It did not join the argument. That is the whole of the news.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Open it on the board, not in a fist. If it has survived the lane, it can survive being looked at.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: It has survived. Put it where the wasps are not. Thou mayst have it after the water, not before.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Then the race was for nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The race was an argument. The boats have not been made. The water is still the middle of the afternoon, and not the whole of it.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I have already named mine. A name is not a boat, and I am not telling it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The book is in my hand. You said after dinner. Dinner is eaten.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Toward the middle of the afternoon. Not the whole of it. Thou hast heard me once. I am not making a second law of it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I heard you at the loaf. I am bringing the book. I am not bringing a complaint.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The knife is thy father's. Take it from the shop, and bring it back in the belt. I am not explaining a loss to him at supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three wands, if the willow gives them. One each. The knife comes home.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: And the three of them come home to me before thou art gone up the field. I have beans. I am still saying beans.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Beans are after the arch. He said the middle, not the whole.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: He did. See that the middle stays a middle. I want the path while the light is still light.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We go when the knife is in the belt. We come when I say. The book stays with Susanna. The cloth stays here.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: If the cloth stays, the corner stays. I am not racing a pie that is sitting down.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Then leave it sitting. I am taking the book to the door. I am waiting for the knife, and not for a new rule.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Wash the lane off, all three. I will not have the road in the river and then in my kitchen.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: My hands are the lane. The river will have them anyway.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The river may. This board may not have them twice. Out, and back when the knife is a fact.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Out, then. The middle of the afternoon is not a rumour.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: The cloth stays. I have said where. Bring the knife back with the three.
